semiconductor_relevance: High — SICO Technology GmbH specializes in high-purity silicon, quartz glass, and ceramics specifically for the semiconductor industry.
summary: SICO Technology GmbH produces high-purity silicon, quartz glass, and ceramics for the semiconductor industry, focusing on components for various OEM furnace brands. They also offer refurbishment, cleaning, and repair services for semiconductor components.
capabilities: High-purity silicon carriers for LPCVD processes
Quartz glass components for thermal processing
technical_expertise: Thermal processing techniques including diffusion and oxidation
